fn edgeInitCompat(
    allocator: Allocator,
    src: []const u8,
    dst: []const u8,

    fractal_dim: f64,
) Edge {

    const info = @typeInfo(@TypeOf(init_fn));
    if (info != .@"fn") {
        @compileError("Edge.init is not a function");
    }
    const params_len = info.@"fn".params.len;
    return switch (params_len) {
        7 => Edge.init(allocator, src, dst, quality, weight, correlation, fractal_dim),
        6 => Edge.init(src, dst, quality, weight, correlation, fractal_dim),
        else => @compileError("Unsupported Edge.init signature"),
    };
}

fn quantumStateCloneCompat(state: QuantumState) QuantumState {
    if (@hasDecl(QuantumState, "clone")) {
        const clone_fn = QuantumState.clone;
        const info = @typeInfo(@TypeOf(clone_fn));
        if (info == .@"fn") {
            const params_len = info.@"fn".params.len;
            return switch (params_len) {
                1 => state.clone(),
                else => state,
            };
        }
    }
    return state;
}

pub const ExecutionHistoryEntry = struct {
    action: ExecutionAction,
    primary_target: []const u8,
    secondary_targets: ArrayList([]const u8),
    operation_type: ?[]const u8,
    result_value: ?[]const u8,
    result_int: ?i64,
    result_float: ?f64,
    timestamp: i128,
    allocator: Allocator,

    const Self = @This();

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, action: ExecutionAction, primary_target: []const u8) !Self {
        return Self{
            .action = action,
            .primary_target = try allocator.dupe(u8, primary_target),
            .secondary_targets = ArrayList([]const u8).init(allocator),
            .operation_type = null,
            .result_value = null,
            .result_int = null,
            .result_float = null,
            .timestamp = std.time.nanoTimestamp(),
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *Self) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.primary_target);
        for (self.secondary_targets.items) |target| {
            self.allocator.free(target);
        }
        self.secondary_targets.deinit();
        if (self.operation_type) |op| {
            self.allocator.free(op);
        }
        if (self.result_value) |rv| {
            self.allocator.free(rv);
        }
    }

    pub fn addSecondaryTarget(self: *Self, target: []const u8) !void {
        const target_copy = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, target);
        try self.secondary_targets.append(target_copy);
    }

    pub fn setOperationType(self: *Self, op_type: []const u8) !void {
        if (self.operation_type) |existing| {
            self.allocator.free(existing);
        }
        self.operation_type = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, op_type);
    }

    pub fn setResultValue(self: *Self, value: []const u8) !void {
        if (self.result_value) |existing| {
            self.allocator.free(existing);
        }
        self.result_value = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, value);
    }

    pub fn setResultInt(self: *Self, value: i64) void {
        self.result_int = value;
    }

    pub fn setResultFloat(self: *Self, value: f64) void {
        self.result_float = value;
    }

    pub fn clone(self: *const Self, allocator: Allocator) !Self {
        var new_entry = Self{
            .action = self.action,
            .primary_target = try allocator.dupe(u8, self.primary_target),
            .secondary_targets = ArrayList([]const u8).init(allocator),
            .operation_type = null,
            .result_value = null,
            .result_int = self.result_int,
            .result_float = self.result_float,
            .timestamp = self.timestamp,
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
        errdefer new_entry.deinit();

        for (self.secondary_targets.items) |target| {
            try new_entry.addSecondaryTarget(target);
        }

        if (self.operation_type) |op| {
            new_entry.operation_type = try allocator.dupe(u8, op);
        }
        if (self.result_value) |rv| {
            new_entry.result_value = try allocator.dupe(u8, rv);
        }

        return new_entry;
    }
};

fn edgeInitCompat(
    allocator: Allocator,
    src: []const u8,
    dst: []const u8,
    quality: EdgeQuality,
    weight: f64,
    correlation: anytype,
    fractal_dim: f64,
) Edge {
    const init_fn = Edge.init;
    const info = @typeInfo(@TypeOf(init_fn));
    if (info != .@"fn") {
        @compileError("Edge.init is not a function");
    }
    const params_len = info.@"fn".params.len;
    return switch (params_len) {
        7 => Edge.init(allocator, src, dst, quality, weight, correlation, fractal_dim),
        6 => Edge.init(src, dst, quality, weight, correlation, fractal_dim),
        else => @compileError("Unsupported Edge.init signature"),
    };
}

fn quantumStateCloneCompat(state: QuantumState) QuantumState {
    if (@hasDecl(QuantumState, "clone")) {
        const clone_fn = QuantumState.clone;
        const info = @typeInfo(@TypeOf(clone_fn));
        if (info == .@"fn") {
            const params_len = info.@"fn".params.len;
            return switch (params_len) {
                1 => state.clone(),
                else => state,
            };
        }
    }
    return state;
}

            self.allocator.free(existing);
        }
        self.operation_type = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, op_type);
    }

    pub fn setResultValue(self: *Self, value: []const u8) !void {
        if (self.result_value) |existing| {
            self.allocator.free(existing);
        }
        self.result_value = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, value);
    }

    pub fn setResultInt(self: *Self, value: i64) void {
        self.result_int = value;
    }

    pub fn setResultFloat(self: *Self, value: f64) void {
        self.result_float = value;
    }

    pub fn clone(self: *const Self, allocator: Allocator) !Self {
        var new_entry = Self{
            .action = self.action,
            .primary_target = try allocator.dupe(u8, self.primary_target),
            .secondary_targets = ArrayList([]const u8).init(allocator),
            .operation_type = null,
            .result_value = null,
            .result_int = self.result_int,
            .result_float = self.result_float,
            .timestamp = self.timestamp,
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
        errdefer new_entry.deinit();

        for (self.secondary_targets.items) |target| {
            try new_entry.addSecondaryTarget(target);
        }

        if (self.operation_type) |op| {
            new_entry.operation_type = try allocator.dupe(u8, op);
        }
        if (self.result_value) |rv| {
            new_entry.result_value = try allocator.dupe(u8, rv);
        }

        return new_entry;
    }
};

fn edgeInitCompat(
    allocator: Allocator,
    src: []const u8,
    dst: []const u8,
    quality: EdgeQuality,
    weight: f64,
    correlation: anytype,
    fractal_dim: f64,
) Edge {
    const init_fn = Edge.init;
    const info = @typeInfo(@TypeOf(init_fn));
    if (info != .@"fn") {
        @compileError("Edge.init is not a function");
    }
    const params_len = info.@"fn".params.len;
    return switch (params_len) {
        7 => Edge.init(allocator, src, dst, quality, weight, correlation, fractal_dim),
        6 => Edge.init(src, dst, quality, weight, correlation, fractal_dim),
        else => @compileError("Unsupported Edge.init signature"),
    };
}

fn quantumStateCloneCompat(state: QuantumState) QuantumState {
    if (@hasDecl(QuantumState, "clone")) {
        const clone_fn = QuantumState.clone;
        const info = @typeInfo(@TypeOf(clone_fn));
        if (info == .@"fn") {
            const params_len = info.@"fn".params.len;
            return switch (params_len) {
                1 => state.clone(),
                else => state,
            };
        }
    }
    return state;
}
